main_measure.name: mean unusual 1-day move in the short direction (next-day return minus coin's normal 1-day drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting check passing; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: deeper half minus shallower half of |forecast|, mean unusual move (Welch), above 0 (Welch t 3.411)

decided_by: The mean unusual move is positive with t >= 2 and the deeper half shows a larger mean than the shallower half.
reading: Situation = 1-day return > 0, 5-day return < 0 and 60-day return < -10 % (the falling-profile veto), with the recorded regime used where a return cannot be computed inside the window; cases are the workflow's bets (forecast rising on its side by >= 2 points) on every bar of the 1-bar grid; the day-clustered t uses per-day summed deviations with a G/(G-1) correction; the deeper half is the top floor(n/2) cases by |forecast| (stable sort), the rest is the shallower half; the plan's 'fewer is inconclusive' is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow; values are fractions.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001416 on the check folds against +0.005364 on every fold
